name: K-C DuPont Distribution Center (KCDC) - DuPont WA

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed: 1205 Wharf Rd, DuPont WA - 'Building 1' of The Cubes at DuPont, a 747,488 sq ft Class-A distribution facility 100% leased to Kimberly-Clark (CRG / The Registry). The Cubes is a 1.6M sq ft, 3-building park on the former Intel campus / DuPont Corporate Center in the Northwest Landing community. Building 1 is the largest of the three buildings - the big N-S cross-dock structure at ~47.1128,-122.6380. Roster ROOFTOP coords moved 1879 m and landed near the cluster center; corrected to Building 1.
fieldNotes.truckGate: TRUE - current (2026 Maxar) z20 satellite of the south truck-court entrance clearly shows a guard booth standing in the middle of the truck driveway with traffic lanes splitting around it (inbound lanes marked with arrows) and yellow-hatched median islands. Facility directory listings independently state 'Check in is required at the security guard for appointments only.'
fieldNotes.guardShack: TRUE - the mid-lane structure at the gate is a guard booth (~1-vehicle footprint, lanes routed around it). remoteGs therefore false.
fieldNotes.docks: Cross-dock building with continuous dock banks and trailers backed in along BOTH long faces (east and west). Well into 50+; dockDoorCount ~130 is an honest overhead estimate for the two faces combined (loose).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: TRUE - cross-dock = two dock banks on opposite building faces.
fieldNotes.dropYard: TRUE - extensive marked trailer-parking lanes east of the building, full of tractorless trailers; dropArea 50+.
fieldNotes.entryExit: Single combined truck gate at the south end. The lanes split around the guard booth - approx 2 inbound lanes and 1 outbound; entryExitTogether true. Lane counts are estimates from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: TRUE - deep paved truck courts inside the gate give 3+ trucks of stacking room before the docks; drivewayLong true.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: TRUE - the gate apron is wide with a multi-lane split around the booth, leaving room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.rail: FALSE - no rail spur into the property (former Intel campus redevelopment; the BNSF mainline runs well to the NE near the I-5 corridor but does not serve the site).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: DuPont is a small city on the I-5 corridor in the southern fringe of the Seattle-Tacoma metro. The Cubes sits in a forested industrial park (Northwest Landing / DuPont Corporate Center) on the edge of town. Borderline - classified Rural per the rubric's 'when torn between small-town industrial and Urban, choose Rural' guidance; flagged in uncertainFields.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~54 acres derived from the perimeter box around Building 1's fenced property (building + both truck courts + east trailer yard + south gate).
